name: harness-ship
description: Idea → shipped, humans on the ends. A self-contained development and testing workflow with explicit human judgment gates.

interface.longDescription: Turn an idea into an accepted change through clarification, feasibility, specification, pre-implementation acceptance scenarios, evidence-backed test-driven implementation, review, testing, and a plain-language acceptance report.
defaultPrompt: Set up harness-ship for this repository.
Run the development workflow for this feature.
Implement this ticket test-first with an evidence-backed red-green loop.
Run the testing workflow for the current change.
